verified_facts.text: The Joule is a revitalized neo-Gothic landmark in the center of downtown Dallas.
verified_facts.excerpt: A revitalized, neo-Gothic landmark in the center of downtown

verified_facts.text: The Joule is on Main Street in downtown Dallas, at 1530 Main St.
verified_facts.excerpt: 1530 Main St., Dallas, Texas 75201

verified_facts.text: The rooftop pool is cantilevered, giving swimmers the sensation of swimming out beyond the hotel's edge.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Joule's unique 8-foot cantilevered pool provides guests the sensation of swimming out beyond the hotel's edge

verified_facts.text: The rooftop pool has skyline views.
verified_facts.excerpt: With stunning skyline views and insta-worthy drinks, The Joule Pool conjures a feeling of sophistication and urban cool.

verified_facts.text: The rooftop pool area has a bar where guests can order drinks from a lounger.
verified_facts.excerpt: Paradise beckons. Order a round, find a lounger, and indulge yourself at our rooftop oasis.

verified_facts.text: The Spa at The Joule is a subterranean spa with a holistic approach to wellness.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Spa at The Joule is a subterranean oasis with a holistic approach to wellness.

verified_facts.text: Spa treatments include custom facials, holistic body rituals and restorative massages.
verified_facts.excerpt: Custom facials, holistic body rituals, and restorative massages are among the most sought-after treatments.

verified_facts.text: The spa offers European heat experiences, and guests can arrive about an hour before their appointment to use them.
verified_facts.excerpt: Come an hour or so before your actual appointment to indulge in the European heat experiences.

verified_facts.text: The 9th-floor Fitness Center has Technogym aerobic and strength-training equipment, free weights, wellness balls and yoga mats.
verified_facts.excerpt: The space is outfitted with Technogym aerobic and strength-training equipment, free weights, wellness balls, and yoga mats.

verified_facts.text: CBD Provisions is a brasserie that is French in method and Texan in manner, with dishes celebrating local ingredients.
verified_facts.excerpt: French in method, Texan in manner, stop in to enjoy longtime favorites and a selection of new dishes crafted to celebrate local ingredients.

verified_facts.text: Sassetta is an Italian destination restaurant open daily for breakfast, lunch and dinner, with brunch on weekends.
verified_facts.excerpt: Open daily for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, with brunch on weekends.

verified_facts.text: Sassetta's popular dishes include lobster spaghetti and burnt honey pizza.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sassetta is a popular Italian eatery with popular dishes like lobster spaghetti and burnt honey pizza.

verified_facts.text: Midnight Rambler is a subterranean cocktail bar reached down a flight of stairs.
verified_facts.excerpt: Follow the lightning and descend a flight of stairs to be transported to another world in our subterranean cocktail bar.

verified_facts.text: Midnight Rambler is led by Dallas bartender Gabe Sanchez.
verified_facts.excerpt: led by one of the most well-respected bartenders in the city, Gabe Sanchez.

verified_facts.text: Weekend Coffee in the lobby uses beans from Counter Culture.
verified_facts.excerpt: Latte lovers will swoon for the lobby's Weekend Coffee with beans from Counter Culture.

verified_facts.text: The Mosaic Bar is a lobby bar for a first drink or a nightcap.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Mosaic Bar is a fitting spot to start your night or wind down with a nightcap.

verified_facts.text: Art by Tony Tasset, Andy Warhol and Millard Sheets is on display starting in the lobby.
verified_facts.excerpt: this art-inspired hotel is filled with works from brilliant artists like Tony Tasset, Andy Warhol, Millard Sheets, and more from the moment you walk into the lobby.

verified_facts.text: A giant 30-foot eyeball sculpture stands across the street from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: check out the giant 30-foot eyeball across the street.

verified_facts.text: All rooms include a mini bar, complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, 400-thread-count Kassatex linens, Salt & Stone amenities, a rainfall shower and down pillows and comforter.
verified_facts.excerpt: All rooms include: mini bar, complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, flat-screen HDTV, 400-thread-count Kassatex linens, spa-like bathrooms, Salt & Stone amenities, rainfall shower, and down pillows and comforter.

verified_facts.text: The Loft Suite is a two-story suite with 20-foot ceilings.
verified_facts.excerpt: This newly reimagined two-story loft suite offers a modern escape with 20-foot ceilings and open, artful spaces.

verified_facts.text: The Terrace Suite has a terrace overlooking Main Street.
verified_facts.excerpt: features high ceilings, floor-to-ceiling windows, and a 60-sq-ft terrace overlooking vibrant Main Street

verified_facts.text: The Joule Penthouse has a pool table, private library, kitchenette and two terraces.
verified_facts.excerpt: Expansive living and dining areas feature ample seating, pool table, private library, kitchenette, and two terraces for alfresco enjoyment.

verified_facts.text: The concierge team can arrange access to cultural venues and offer restaurant recommendations.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our world-class concierge team can arrange access to must-attend cultural venues, offer thoughtful restaurant recommendations

verified_facts.text: The hotel runs art programming, dining experiences and wellness events.
verified_facts.excerpt: Art programming, dining experiences, unique wellness events
